$Comment: What each player who fought the Yeti sees the instant he falls: his own headline, and under it each
player's share of the fight. Its binding row points its Defeated beat here (Feedback.Defeated). Keys
are lines in this pack's christmas.yeti.lang, written bare.
The moment fires once per credited player and carries 'share' (that player's share of the fight as
whole percent points, the top player reading 100, which is what their daily Claim's rolls were scaled
by) and 'seconds' (how long the fight took), the second line's {0} and {1}. Gold Reward tone and the
game's own snowlands discovery sting. The dungeon's own banner follows it, saying the reward waits in
the chest where the Yeti fell.
